concerns.text: FR-007 requires the final JSON/CSV output to include a `block_length` attribute (used by the Moving Block Bootstrap). The plan’s Phase 10 only mentions exporting `model_results.json` conforming to `model_result.schema.yaml`, but the provided schema does not define a `block_length` field, nor does the narrative state that this attribute will be recorded. This leaves the success criterion untestable.
